cohort: 100,000 Iranian pregnant women from Mashhad, Iran, whose medical records were monitored during the COVID-19 pandemic from March 2020 to November 2021.
finding: Symptomatic COVID-19 infection in pregnant women was significantly associated with older age, underlying diseases, diabetes, a higher rate of cesarean sections, and lower newborn birth weight.
mod_finding: Infected pregnant women underwent cesarean section more frequently compared to healthy pregnant women.
